title: v4.1 configure OpenClaw for native Ollama tool calling
script: $root='C:/3EN-Agent/openclaw-bridge'; $d=Get-Content (Join-Path $root 'discovery.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $models=@($d.ollamaTags); if($models.Count -lt 1){throw 'NO_OLLAMA_MODELS'}; $preferred=@('qwen3:8b','qwen2.5-coder:14b','mistral-nemo','deepseek-r1:14b'); $model=$null; foreach($p in $preferred){if($models -contains $p){$model=$p;break}}; if(-not $model){$model=[string]$models[0]}; [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('OLLAMA_API_KEY','ollama-local','User'); $env:OLLAMA_API_KEY='ollama-local'; & openclaw config set models.providers.ollama.apiKey 'OLLAMA_API_KEY' 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath (Join-Path $root 'config-049.txt') | Out-Null; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'OPENCLAW_OLLAMA_CONFIG_FAILED'}; & openclaw models set ('ollama/'+$model) 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath (Join-Path $root 'model-set-049.txt') | Out-Null; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'OPENCLAW_MODEL_SET_FAILED'}; $model | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root 'selected-model.txt') -Encoding ASCII; Write-Output ('V41_049_MODEL='+$model)
test: $root='C:/3EN-Agent/openclaw-bridge'; $m=(Get-Content (Join-Path $root 'selected-model.txt') -Raw).Trim(); $list=& openclaw models list --provider ollama 2>&1 | Out-String; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'OPENCLAW_OLLAMA_LIST_FAILED'}; if($list -notmatch [regex]::Escape($m)){throw 'SELECTED_MODEL_NOT_VISIBLE'}; $cfg=& openclaw config get models.providers.ollama.apiKey 2>&1 | Out-String; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'OPENCLAW_OLLAMA_CONFIG_NOT_READABLE'}; if($cfg -notmatch 'OLLAMA_API_KEY'){throw 'OLLAMA_API_KEY_REF_MISSING'}; Write-Output 'V41_049_TEST=PASS'
